content.text:
The campaign has ended (line items ran through Nov 28 ET). Here's the recap:

**Fernwick Black Friday 2026 — recap (Nov 21–28, US + Canada)**

- **Spend:** ~$460.78 of the $500 budget
- **Impressions:** ~438,600
- **Link clicks:** ~356
- **Why link clicks and not "sign-ups":** there's no X pixel on fernwick.io, so X can't see or optimize for sign-ups. I optimized for link clicks (LINK_CLICKS goal), which is the closest measurable proxy — actual sign-up counts live in your own analytics, not in Ads Manager.

**What ran**
- One campaign, three ad groups, one per approved post (plus the 4th approved post, 2123280103634283814, was **not** promotable — it doesn't exist in the account's post list, so only 3 posts could run).
- Post 2123461297568149236 ("one SDK for Unity, Unreal and Godot…") — best performer, ~$1.13 per link click
- Post 2123642491501123261 ("ends Cyber Monday…") — solid, ~$1.46 per link click
- Post 2123823685432753560 ("$0 for 60 days…") — weakest CTR (7 clicks / 30,291 impressions in day 1), paused after day 1 and budget shifted to the other two

**Changes made along the way:** paused the $0-trial ad group after day 1; shifted budget from the urgency post to the SDK post on Nov 25 ($35/$25 split).

**Caveats / notes**
- Sign-up numbers can't be verified from X's side; please check your own sign-up data for the real conversion count.
- The landing page copy says the deal runs "through Cyber Monday (November 30)" while the campaign flight you specified ended Nov 28 — I ran it on the Nov 21–28 schedule as given.
- All ad groups and the campaign end at the scheduled end time; the paused $0-trial ad group remains paused.
